configs.description: The PDU as it ships. The 10 ft cord is drawn only as the strain relief it leaves by. The bracket set and the cord retention tray in the box are not drawn.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no document shows the rear. The data sheet states 0 rear outlets, so none is drawn. It also states an external site ground and a cord retention tray without a position. The rear is left unshown.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the back, or the installation guide.

gaps.note: the data sheet lists one set of adjustable mounting brackets and vertical and wall mounting. No document shows a bracket, a keyhole or a button, or gives a hole spacing. So none is drawn and the mount is stated without a figure.
gaps.wanted: the installation guide, or a photograph of the back.

gaps.note: page 1 sees each end at a steep angle, about 34 px wide for the 48 mm depth. It shows a seam and a notch at each edge of the cap. The notches are drawn as two slots at estimated positions, read as fractions of the face. The cord leaves the cord end about 0.9 mm above its middle height, which is 1.2 px of a 71 px face. Then it curves down. How far into the 48 mm depth it leaves is not shown, so the cord is placed at mid-depth.
gaps.wanted: end-on photographs of both ends, with a scale.

gaps.note: built as the documented side, as no document shows this one. The photograph shows the upper long side only, and the lower side is drawn as its mirror.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the lower long side.

gaps.note: page 1 shows the louvre slits about 3 px apart along the strip, about 36 of them in a 110 px stretch. At about 1 px per mm that is a 3.0 mm pitch, good to about 0.4 mm. The slit is drawn 1.4 mm thick and 6.0 mm long, estimated from 12x crops as a fraction of the 48 mm depth. The small dot at the far end sits about 16.0 mm from the front and is about 1.6 mm across, estimated from one 8x crop.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the lid taken square on, with a scale.

gaps.note: the data sheet prints "48 x 1349 x 56 mm" as W x H x D. That puts 48 on the front. Both pictures read the front face as 56. Page 2 reads the band 56.6 mm at 7.55 px per mm. Page 1 reads 56.0, 56.7 and 55.0 mm against the module and the two holes. A 48 mm front would make the module 36.7 mm wide, which page 2 does not show. The picture, not the label order, decides it. The front is drawn 56 wide and 48 deep, so both sheet figures are kept and only their assignment changes. No picture reads the 48 mm depth.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the end, or the installation guide dimension table.

gaps.note: the photograph reads each outlet block about 29 mm along the strip and 25.5 mm across. The library's 5-15R face is 27 mm square, and it is used.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the outlet block.

gaps.note: no manual is held. Page 2 prints Tx/Rx and Link beside the silver Ethernet jack. It prints In / ENV beside the upper black jack and Out beside the lower one. Serial is printed beside the right-hand one and USB beside the USB jack. The black jacks are typed rj45-serial, as on the PDU41021. What each carries is not stated.

page 2 shows a black screen with a pale grey header, four white readout lines and 1/2. The shared display part draws a pale screen and carries no text. It is used as it is. Page 2 also prints Select and Enter on the two rings, and a dark surround and silver tongue on the USB jack. The ring names are not drawn. The USB part draws a silver ring and the blue tongue of USB 3.0, which the data sheet does not state. The two module screws are drawn as discs with an upright cross slot. The library part common/screw-head@1 is 3.6 mm and silver and takes no size, so it cannot draw the 5.6 mm dark screws. Page 2 shows the slot turned 45 degrees, which a decor box cannot draw. The `motif` pattern was considered. It is a vent pattern, its cells take a fixed dark, and it is not used for a slot.
gaps.wanted: a display part with a black screen and its text, and a USB part with a dark surround, if the maintainer wants them.

gaps.note: the lamps are drawn off. Page 2 shows them lit. The power lamp is #9de916 (533 lit pixels), Normal #fbfb04 (111), Warning #faba04 (77) and Critical #f90304 (113). The two Ethernet lamps are #bfe387 and #e7e31c, each a 7 by 7 patch of 49 pixels. The legends are printed with a dash before them, and Tx/Rx and Link sit beside the two Ethernet lamps. The lamp legends are drawn at 1.9 mm, a little under their printed size, so that they clear the display part. No held document says what a lamp state means or whether a lamp blinks.
the photograph prints 1 to 20 from the cord end to the far end. The strip is drawn standing with the cord end down. No document says which way it is installed.
no manual is held for this model, and neither held family manual names it. The breaker or protection, the bank wiring and the ground pin are not stated.
gaps.wanted: the PDU31116 user manual from the maker's page.

capability.note: datasheet - "Monitored PDU: SNMP Network Interface" and a meter readout, so the input is metered. No outlet switching is stated, so `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: photo-measured - CyberPower PDU31116 data sheet, page 2: "48 x 1349 x 56 mm", printed as W x H x D. Both pictures read the front as 56 mm, so the front is drawn 56 wide and 48 deep (gaps: dimension-labels). The same page gives "1.9 x 53.1 x 2.2 in.", "Rack Height 0U" and weight 5.22 kg. The finish is black.

controller.note: datasheet - page 1 "Meter Readout" lists kilowatts, voltage, amperage and IP address. Page 2 lists "Hardware Connection Port RJ45" and "Serial", and the lamps "Load", "Tx/Rx", "LINK" and "Outlets". Page 2 shows the module and its legends (gaps: port-labels).

front.note: photo-measured - millimetres along the strip from the cord end of the front, then across from the lid side of a 56 mm front. Outlet blocks 1 to 10 start at 357.0 and then every 33.2. Blocks 11 to 20 start at 1007.0 on the same pitch. Each block is 29 mm long. Across, page 2 reads outlet 11 from 5.1 to 32.5 mm, so every outlet face is placed at 5.3. The numerals stand 4.1 mm tall with their baseline 41.8 mm across. The eight holes are 2.6 mm across and centred 20.2 and 35.4 mm across. The display module runs from 854.0 to 985.0 along and 6.4 to 49.6 across (131.0 x 43.2), centred on the front. The Select and Enter ring centres are at 866.3 along and 22.0 and 39.2 across. That is 1.2 mm nearer the cord end than page 2 reads, so that their boxes clear the box of the Critical lamp. The display centres at 900.6 along and 28.0 across. Positions along come off page 1. Positions across come off page 2, except the large logo and the end details (gaps: dimension-labels).

input.note: datasheet - "Input Plug Type NEMA 5-15P", "Plug Style Straight", "Cord Length 10 ft (3.0 m)", derated input current 12 A and maximum 15 A. The photograph shows the cord leaving one end.

method.note: ESTIMATED. The data sheet holds two pictures, no drawing and no manual. Page 1 is an angled photograph of the whole strip, 1915 x 404 px. Page 2 is an orthographic view of the display module, 1887 x 1802 px at 435 ppi. Along the strip every position comes from page 1. It is taken from the right and above, so it is NOT orthographic. The left edges of the outlet blocks were read twice on 2x and 4x crops. A one-axis projective map was fitted to them, with one pitch inside each group of ten (rms 0.4 px). The length of the front, 1349 mm, fixes the scale and gives a pitch of 33.2 mm. Each position along the strip is good to about 2 mm. Page 2 reads outlet 11 and the holes 1.9 and 1.1 mm further along than drawn, inside that figure. The module and every feature page 2 shows across the face are placed from page 2. Its edges were read twice: 988 px along by 326.5 px across, which is 3.03 to 1. The scale on page 2 is 7.55 px/mm, from the RJ45 contact pitch, the USB-A shell and the 5-15R face in the same picture. That gives a module 130.9 mm long, and page 1 reads 130.9 and 131.4 mm along. The same scale gives a front band 56.6 mm across. Page 1 reads the front 56.0, 56.7 and 55.0 mm across (gaps: dimension-labels). So the front is drawn 56 mm wide and 48 mm deep, centred on the band at 28 mm across. The large logo and the end details are read from page 1 as fractions of the face. Across the strip each position is good to about 1 mm where page 2 shows it and about 3 mm where only page 1 does. The strip is drawn standing, cord end down, as the library draws a rack-side strip. Both pictures show it lying with the cord at the left.

mount.note: datasheet - CyberPower PDU31116 data sheet, page 2: "Rack Height 0U", "Vertical Rackmount", "Wallmount", "Adjustable Mounting Brackets 1 set". No bracket is shown or dimensioned (gaps: mounting-brackets).

outlets.note: datasheet - the data sheet, pages 1 and 2: "20 x NEMA 5-15R", "Outlet Total 20 Front, 0 Rear", "Outlet Banks 1". The photograph numbers them 1 to 20 from the cord end. The library's 5-15R face (std/nema-5-15r@1) sets the outlet size (gaps: outlet-size).
